The CT Venn remains in section 5. Here show modification support within its PTM CT regions. Modification categories can overlap; "Other modified evidence" excludes Phospho (STY) so the stacked support groups are disjoint.

```{r setup}
source("CoPPRA_config_SEA.R",local=TRUE)
source("CoPPRA_validation_SEA.R",local=TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
validation_theme_SEA()
paths_SEA <- stage_paths_SEA("CT_modifications")
plot_folder_SEA <- paths_SEA$plots
x <- readRDS(file.path(paths_SEA$data,"CT_modifications_SEA.rds"))

clean_plot_text_SEA <- function(p) {
  p +
    labs(subtitle = NULL, caption = NULL, tag = NULL) +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
      plot.caption = element_blank(),
      plot.tag = element_blank()
    )
}
```

# Plot CT modification support

```{r ct_support,fig.width=8.5,fig.height=6}
z <- copy(x$annotation)
z[,Support:=fifelse(Has_Phospho_STY,"Phospho (STY)",fifelse(Has_modified_evidence,"Other modified evidence","Unmodified evidence only"))]
a <- z[,.(Proteins=.N),by=.(CT_region,Support)]
p <- ggplot(a,aes(CT_region,Proteins,fill=Support))+geom_col(width=.65)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("Phospho (STY)"="#D55E00","Other modified evidence"="#E6AB02","Unmodified evidence only"="#BDBDBD"))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=display_label_SEA)+
  labs(title="Modification support for PTM CT proteins",x=NULL,y="CT protein accessions",fill=NULL)+
  theme(legend.position="bottom")
p <- clean_plot_text_SEA(p)
print(p);save_plot_SEA(p,"CT_modification_support",8.5,5.5,dpi=600)
p <- ggplot(x$categories,aes(reorder(Category,CT_proteins),CT_proteins))+geom_col(fill="#E88931")+
  coord_flip()+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.05)))+
  labs(title="Modification categories in PTM CT",x=NULL,y="CT protein accessions")
p <- clean_plot_text_SEA(p)
print(p);save_plot_SEA(p,"CT_modification_categories",8.5,5.5,dpi=600)
save_session_SEA(paths_SEA$plots)
```
